subject.title: fix(agents): tighten grepSchema context/limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should the built-in grep tool intentionally reject fractional `context` and `limit` values at the model-facing schema boundary?
rationale: The implementation correctly enforces integer semantics, but it narrows a previously accepted tool-call contract; repository policy requires explicit owner intent for that compatibility choice.

options.title: Adopt integer-only contract
options.body: Approve strict fractional-value rejection and land after extracting the schema into a lightweight shared module.

options.title: Preserve permissive contract
options.body: Keep the number schema and normalize or reject fractional values during execution without narrowing the advertised contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt integer-only contract
recommendation.body: Approve strict fractional-value rejection and land after extracting the schema into a lightweight shared module.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly identifies Tyler with the agents/subagents area, making him the best available owner for this built-in tool-contract choice.
